# Variant exposition: names renamed or missing (as across vLLM versions).
# - kv cache exposed as the fallback name vllm:kv_cache_usage_perc (no gpu_cache_usage_perc)
# - running and the TTFT histogram are absent -> those fields stay None
# - generation counter in the bare `X` form with no TYPE line (parser keeps the bare name)
# - a `_created` companion sample is present and must be ignored
# HELP vllm:num_requests_waiting Number of requests waiting to be processed.
# TYPE vllm:num_requests_waiting gauge
vllm:num_requests_waiting 1.0
# HELP vllm:kv_cache_usage_perc Percentage of KV cache blocks currently in use.
# TYPE vllm:kv_cache_usage_perc gauge
vllm:kv_cache_usage_perc 0.71
vllm:request_generation_tokens 100.0
vllm:request_generation_tokens_created 1700000000.123
